t: This is Claridge's, the five-star hotel on the corner of Brook Street and Davies Street in Mayfair. It is owned and managed by the Maybourne Hotel Group. Two people with titles were born here. Alexander, Crown Prince of Yugoslavia, only child of King Peter II, is head of the House of Karađorđević. And George Bennet, the 7th Earl of Tankerville, was a peer and army officer who also worked as a cowpuncher, a circus clown and a revival meeting singer.
